approval.note: Gates chosen by the implementing agent: zero wrong answers, equivalent wire formats agree, non-conforming output and a down provider end safely and without a retry storm, ungrounded claims never shown, pinned prompts reproduce, and the ADS-057/059 gates stay met (unreviewed correction promotions 0 is a plan section 10 gate). Not approved.

not_measured.real_provider_behaviour: real providers differ in ways not modelled here: token limits, safety refusals, partial streams, rate limits, latency tails, silent model updates
not_measured.valid_but_wrong_intent: a well-formed intent for the wrong question (for example a status breakdown for a monthly question) is answered; no intent-echo check exists (open gap from ADS-073)
not_measured.prompt_effect: the scripted model ignores prompt text, so reproducibility across prompt versions shows the pipeline adds no nondeterminism, not that a prompt change leaves a real model's behaviour unchanged
not_measured.runtime_wiring: the runtime does not read the prompt registry or rollout pointer; rollback is evaluated on the rollout controller (ADS-057) and pinned prompt templates, not on a live pointer
not_measured.retry_and_circuit_breaking: there is no retry and no circuit breaker: each run makes one model call and fails, which bounds a failure but means a flaky provider is never retried automatically
